1.

In the depth of God’s heart There lay a great thought; That thought was So wondrous, A counsel of the Most High, Where pure love dwells. In the depth of God’s heart Lay hidden a great thought.

2.

From eternity God thought Of a chosen bride, In Christ’s beauty, The reward of His toil, Who, before the world was created, Was foreseen by God. From eternity God thought Of Christ and His bride.

3.

He is the bright shining Of all God’s glory. In Him was God manifest, And the bride shall proclaim His praise in eternity, He who is the reflection Of all God’s glory.
